title: Quiet human-friendly CLI output when not run by an agent
description: Every create and comment prints a five-line provenance warning suggesting Cursor/Composer flags, and comment prints Markdown suggestions. Comment authors are always 'unknown'. Detect an interactive human (TTY, no agent env) and drop agent nags; use git user.name as author. Also unify id display (short ids everywhere, consistent case in console) and make errors list valid choices.
